arxiv-2106-05974.title: Scaling Vision with Sparse Mixture of Experts
arxiv-2106-05974.creator: Carlos Riquelme, Joan Puigcerver *, Basil Mustafa *, Maxim Neumann, Rodolphe Jenatton, André Susano Pinto, Daniel Keysers, Neil Houlsby
arxiv-2106-05974.description: Abstract Sparsely-gated Mixture of Experts networks (MoEs) have demonstrated excellent scalability in Natural Language Processing. In Computer Vision, however, almost all performant networks are “dense”, that is, every input is processed by every parameter. We present a Vision MoE (V-MoE), a sparse version of the Vision Transformer, that is scalable and competitive with the largest dense networks.

arxiv-2109-00233.title: Empirical evidence for a jamming transition in urban traffic
arxiv-2109-00233.creator: Erwan Taillanter, Marc Barthelemy
arxiv-2109-00233.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Erwan Taillanter, Marc Barthelemy. Understanding the mechanisms leading to the formation and the propagation of traffic jams in large cities is of crucial importance for urban planning and traffic management. Many studies have already considered the emergence of traffic jams from the point of view of phase transitions, but mostly in simple geometries such as highways for example, or in the framework of percolation where an external parameter is driving the transition.

arxiv-2301-11224.title: Cohomological properties of absolute Galois groups and their profinite completion.
arxiv-2301-11224.creator: Tamar Bar-On
arxiv-2301-11224.description: Abstract We prove that several properties of absolute Galois groups are preserved under a profinite completion. Introduction Profinite groups were first introduced in 1928 by Wolfgang Krull, who proved that regarded as a topological group with the Krull topology, every Galois group of a field extension is compact, Hausdorff and totally disconnected, ( [ 12 ] ).

arxiv-2407-10316.title: Online Matroid Embeddings
arxiv-2407-10316.creator: Andrés Cristi, Paul Dütting, Robert Kleinberg, Renato Paes Leme, Neel Patel
arxiv-2407-10316.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrés Cristi, Paul Dütting, Robert Kleinberg, Renato Paes Leme, Neel Patel. We introduce the notion of an online matroid embedding, which is an algorithm for mapping an unknown matroid that is revealed in an online fashion to a larger-but-known matroid. We establish the existence of such an embedding for binary matroids, and use it to relate variants of the binary matroid secretary problem to each other, showing that seemingly simpler problems are in fact equivalent to seemingly harder ones (up to constant-factors).

arxiv-2411-17468.title: Adversarial Bounding Boxes Generation (ABBG) Attack against Visual Object Trackers
arxiv-2411-17468.creator: Fatemeh Nourilenjan Nokabadi, Jean-François Lalonde, Christian Gagné
arxiv-2411-17468.description: Abstract Adversarial perturbations aim to deceive neural networks into predicting inaccurate results. For visual object trackers, adversarial attacks have been developed to generate perturbations by manipulating the outputs. However, transformer trackers predict a specific bounding box instead of an object candidate list, which limits the applicability of many existing attack scenarios.

pmc-10650937.creator: Kai Feng, Ling Chen, Xinle Zhang, Jiang Gong, Jinping Qu, Ran Niu, Bernard Doudin
pmc-10650937.description: Swarms of self-propelled micromotors can mimic the processes of natural systems and construct artificial intelligent materials to perform complex collective behaviors. Compared to self-propelled Janus micromotors, the isotropic colloid motors, also called micromotors or microswimmers, have advantages in self-assembly to form micromotor swarms, which are efficient in resistance to external disturbance and the delivery of large quantity of cargos.

pmc-10745622.creator: Chunsheng Li, Yaoyang Chen, Feihua Ye, Junhua Chen, Jia Zheng
pmc-10745622.description: A straightforward and convenient protocol was established for the synthesis of thiophosphates and 3-sulfenylated indoles via low-valent-tungsten-catalyzed aerobic oxidative cross-dehydrogenative coupling reactions. These reactions occur under mild conditions and simple operations with commercially available starting materials, processing the advantage of excellent atom and step economy, broad substrate scope, and good functional groups tolerance.

pmc-10746050.title: Effects of Wood Content and Modification on Properties of Wood Flour/Polybutylene Adipate Terephthalate Biocomposites
pmc-10746050.creator: Wangwang Yu, Rui Qiu, Mengya Li, Wen Lei, Youhong Tang
pmc-10746050.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Biodegradable polymers have recently become attractive and have been increasingly used as matrix materials to replace fossil plastics due to concerns about the environmental issue. However, their application areas are limited due to their high costs and natural properties. In this study, we fabricated ecofriendly and economical polybutylene adipate terephthalate (PBAT) composites loaded with various concentrations of wood flour (WF) to investigate the effects on the PBAT and WF interfaces as well as the physical properties of the WF/PBAT biocomposites.

pmc-12514022.creator: Feixiang Lv, Yong Zhang, Fanjie Kong, Xiaobin Li, Quanle Zou
pmc-12514022.description: When a coal pillar serves as part of the dam structure in an underground coal mine reservoir, it is subjected to the combined effects of water immersion and dynamic loading. Therefore, understanding the mechanical properties of coal under such conditions is crucial for assessing the stability of underground coal mine reservoirs.

pmc-12594264.title: USH2A-Mutated Human Retinal Organoids Model Rod–Cone Dystrophy

pmc-13617782.title: Periodontitis prevalence and effects on postoperative complications in gastric surgery: a prospective observational study
pmc-13617782.creator: Emil A Pettersson, Tiina Vuorela, Johanna M Louhimo, Jaana Hagström, Caj H Haglund, Timo Sorsa, Hanna E Seppänen, Kethe M Hermunen
pmc-13617782.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis, a progressive inflammatory disease of the tooth-supporting structures, has direct adverse effects on systemic health. Links between periodontitis and gastrointestinal tract malignancies have also emerged in numerous studies. The aim of our study was to uncover the prevalence of periodontitis and its effects on postoperative complications among patients undergoing gastric surgery.

pmc-13682106.title: The reliability and validity study of the Turkish version of the Uncertainty about Disease and Treatment Scale in hemodialysis patients
pmc-13682106.creator: Reva Gündoğan, Onur Çetinkaya, Mümin Savaş
pmc-13682106.description: BackgroundUncertainty is common in chronic illness and can weaken treatment adherence and psychosocial well-being. Hemodialysis involves persistent symptoms and treatment unpredictability, making uncertainty assessment clinically important. This study was methodologically designed to test the psychometric properties of the Turkish form of the Uncertainty about Disease and Treatment Scale (UC-D&TS) in hemodialysis patients.
